messages:
Maria C: Hey team — heads up: planned GPU kernel maintenance + request-priority rollout tomorrow 2025-06-15 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Maria C: We\u2019ll do a rolling upgrade on gpu-pool-3; expected transient 5-15s per instance during kernel switch and a brief KV-cache warmup. No data plane migrations.
Ajay P: What's the SLA impact? :thinking:
Maria C: No SLA change expected. We'll enable soft-degradation for 'bulk' traffic and automatic fallback for 'realtime' to a smaller model if p99 > 500ms during the window.
SRE Oncall: Canaries/timing?
Maria C: Canary at 01:30 UTC on gpu-pool-3a (5% traffic). If canary looks good we'll ramp to 30% at 01:50 then full roll 02:00-03:30 with staged drains/joins. Rollback plan in runbook if p99 or error rate crosses thresholds.
Samira K: Do clients need to change anything?
Maria C: Optional change: we're introducing request-priority header `X-Rw-Priority` with values `realtime | standard | bulk`. If you set `realtime` we try to preserve low tail latency (subject to capacity).
Samira K: Any rate-limit or quota changes for bulk?
Maria C: No permanent rate-limit changes. We will throttle concurrency for 'bulk' during kernel switches to reduce preemption; recommend clients implement retries+exponential-backoff for bulk.
Maria C: Quick examples for integration:
```
# curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Rw-Priority: realtime" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# python (requests)
import requests
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['RW_KEY']}", "X-Rw-Priority": "realtime"}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", headers=headers, json={"model":"rw-v1","input":"hi"})
```
Maria C: SDK patch v0.8.6 (clients) will add a `priority` param to request options today; docs PR open.
DeployBot: Scheduled maintenance: kernel-update-job queued for 2025-06-15T01:30:00Z. Job ID: kj-20250615-01
OpsBot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-kernel-maintenance (see step 4 for rollback checklist).
Ajay P: Who should we page if we see model falls or error-rate spike?
SRE Oncall: Page me (SRE Oncall) and Maria C. Ops runbook contact list contains infra and runtime leads.
Maria C: We'll be posting live status updates in this thread during the window and a short postmortem if anything unexpected happens.
Samira K: I'll cut the client SDK release and docs update this afternoon.
Ajay P: Noted, will adjust traffic shaping for our batch jobs to `bulk`.
SRE Oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. Will run the preflight around 00:45 UTC and report back.
Maria C: Thanks everyone :tada: — ping here if you want to join the preflight call (01:00 UTC). DeployBot: reminder 30m before maintenance.
